summary: xAI added image and voice reference conditioning, prompt-only text-to-video, and native 1080p generation to its existing Grok Imagine Video 1.5 model, available on grok.com, iOS, Android and the xAI API.

practices.reason: The video model now accepts image and voice references for consistent characters/voices and generates natively at 1080p, changing what a team could produce with it.
practices.quote: Today it goes further: image and voice references, video from a prompt alone, and native 1080p generation.

practices.reason: New API parameters (reference_image_urls, resolution) and the model id grok-imagine-video-1.5 are live now, requiring integration work to use references and higher resolution.
practices.quote: Image references, text-to-video, and native 1080p are live in the xAI API with our best video model, grok-imagine-video-1.5 .
